LanguageData.FH_NerveFlesh.label: nerve flesh
LanguageData.FH_NerveFlesh.description: An essential part of flesh nerves. Many complex flesh structures require nerve flesh to complete their construction.
LanguageData.FH_FleshBerry.label: fleshberry
LanguageData.FH_FleshBerry.description: A red, fleshy fruit grown from a twisted flesh bush. It is edible raw, but the dense metallic taste lingers unpleasantly.
LanguageData.FH_DreadmeldSeed.label: dreadmeld seed
LanguageData.FH_DreadmeldSeed.description: The fleshy core of a dreadmeld. It is a tumor-like lump made entirely of flesh, beating endlessly like a heart. A dreadmeld seed can be used to cultivate your own flesh hive or giant fleshbeast.
LanguageData.FH_NexusmeldSeed.label: nexusmeld seed
LanguageData.FH_NexusmeldSeed.description: The fleshy core of a nexusmeld. It is a tumor-like lump made entirely of flesh, with green patterns of nerve tissue growing across it. It beats endlessly like a heart. A nexusmeld seed can be used to cultivate your own giant fleshbeast.
LanguageData.FH_FuriousmeldSeed.label: furiousmeld seed
LanguageData.FH_FuriousmeldSeed.description: The fleshy core of a furiousmeld. It is a tumor-like lump made entirely of flesh, covered with a layer of red carapace. It beats endlessly like a heart. A furiousmeld seed can be used to cultivate your own giant fleshbeast.
LanguageData.FH_FissionmeldSeed.label: fissionmeld seed
LanguageData.FH_FissionmeldSeed.description: The fleshy core of a fissionmeld. It is a tumor-like lump made entirely of flesh, with many bony spikes growing from it. It beats endlessly like a heart. A fissionmeld seed can be used to cultivate your own giant fleshbeast.
LanguageData.FH_BastionmeldSeed.label: bastionmeld seed
LanguageData.FH_BastionmeldSeed.description: The fleshy core of a bastionmeld. It is a tumor-like lump made entirely of flesh, covered with pieces of metallic carapace. It beats endlessly like a heart. A bastionmeld seed can be used to cultivate your own giant fleshbeast.
LanguageData.Tentacle.label: flesh tentacle
LanguageData.Tentacle.description: A fleshy, muscled tentacle resembling a partial transformation into a fleshbeast. The tentacle is excellent at manipulation.\n\nThe flesh tentacle has its own neural structures and may become dangerous if removed.
LanguageData.FH_FleshAdaptationModule.label: flesh adaptation module
LanguageData.FH_FleshAdaptationModule.description: A tumor-like flesh module produced by the flesh hive. After implantation, it subtly reshapes the host's mind, removing disgust toward flesh creatures, flesh-made goods, and twisted meat, and allowing the host to live more easily alongside the flesh hive.
LanguageData.FleshWhip.label: flesh whip
LanguageData.FleshWhip.description: A fleshy, muscled tentacle with a blade at the end. The flesh whip makes an excellent melee weapon.\n\nIt has its own neural structures and may become dangerous if removed.
LanguageData.FleshmassStomach.label: fleshmass stomach
LanguageData.FleshmassStomach.description: A cancerous mass of semi-sentient flesh. The harsh acid it produces is painful, but strong enough to prevent most food poisoning.\n\nThe organ has its own neural structures and may become dangerous if removed.
LanguageData.FleshmassLung.label: fleshmass lung
LanguageData.FleshmassLung.description: A cancerous mass of semi-sentient flesh. The tissue constantly regrows and replaces itself, making it immune to effects like lung rot and asthma.\n\nThe organ has its own neural structures and may become dangerous if removed.
